title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: Cloud held over the slope overnight: expect a lower base. Low cloud is down to about 3,100 ft; the night's dew is evaporating -- Kula Ag's dew point is up 2 °F since 04:05 and it is still 97% humid. Today's forecast: Thermals probably flat. Trades from the NE should put the shear line crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio. Upslope has not set in yet.
